thesis: This episode uses General Motors and Tesla as case studies to contrast traditional management approaches with the 'Elon method,' highlighting specific metrics like deliveries per week and the practice of sleeping on factory floors to create urgency. It also notes that Elon's companies have historically prioritized capital efficiency, while briefly mentioning Twitter's (X) focus on engagement minutes and the resulting criticism regarding URL bans.
